Deep-Tech Quest Addict (Send Help)

Cracking deep-tech quests, arguing philosophy with LLMs, and shaping a product that evolves overnight, it’s the kind of ride every engineer dreams about. I can’t lie, it’s been fun

Meital Avitan Software Engineer

My Neighbors Think I’m in a Cult

I’ve been in mobile gaming for 10 years and never seen anything like Sett. The product is incredible, the demand is insane, and market fit is undeniable. I’m betting bold this will be huge and yes, I scream out of excitement more often than I’d like to admit.

Jonathan Fishman Head of Marketing

Seen a pig fly in a playable ad? That was me.

Day to day, I get to do the crazy mix of building, testing, and reimagining playable ads that millions of people end up clicking on. One hour I’m turning a penguin into a treasure-hunting explorer, the next I’m making pigs fly or rewriting code so an AI can playtest faster than humans. It’s fast, chaotic, and insanely creative, but that’s what makes it exciting.

Nadav Aviran Technical Artist Team Lead

My inbox has performance anxiety

It was an easy decision to leave big corps and join this adventure, because Sett is building where UA mobile gaming is going. With Sett, it’s not a question of ‘if’ a studio will use it, just ‘when’, and the wave keeps getting bigger with every playable ad powered by agentic AI. Exciting times.

Aviv Shayov Partnership Executive
